subject: general
question:
Select the alphanumeric group from the given options that will replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

S77, U52, X32, ? , J7, U2
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20f2114c999d44e2b9f341686c8b872f07c2c826c3b298e33c61b61fdcda7ad5.png] 

The logic followed here is: '**Difference between the positional value of letters are consecutive prime numbers and the numbers are decreasing in the multiple of 5**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61153b0121338d3f88cc78c9ea8a5ce2c0dd49eea56cc7b4fa5f85daac5d9668.png] 

So, **'C17'** will replace the question mark in the given series.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
